project.name: medic
project.summary: A European marketplace and visibility platform for locum (replacement) doctors: a Doctolib-style public professional page plus a marketplace of replacement missions, across France, Belgium, Germany and Switzerland.
project.audience: Locum doctors looking for replacement work and medical practices (cabinets) needing cover.
project.value: Doctors get a public, SEO-indexed profile and matched missions; practices find, contact and book vetted replacements fast across four countries.

enums.name: Role
enums.description: users.role string-union (varchar 20). USER_ROLE_IDS used at registration is [CABINET, DOCTOR]; ADMIN is set via isAdmin/promoteToAdmin.

enums.name: Country
enums.description: users.country and missions.country (varchar 2), default FR.

enums.name: Locale
enums.description: users.locale (varchar 5), default fr. Matches next-intl routing locales; defaultLocale fr, localePrefix as-needed.

enums.name: ProfileStatus
enums.description: Validation state on cabinetProfiles.status and doctorProfiles.status, default PENDING.

enums.name: PractitionerNumberType
enums.description: doctorProfiles.practitionerNumberType: FR=RPPS, BE=INAMI, CH=GLN, DE=APPROBATION.

enums.name: ConsultationType
enums.description: doctorProfiles.consultationTypes (json array), default [remplacement].

enums.name: DoctorIntent
enums.description: doctorProfiles.intent, default both.

enums.name: ContactRequestStatus
enums.description: contactRequests.status, default PENDING. Doctor status-update tRPC only allows VIEWED|REPLIED.

enums.name: NotificationType
enums.description: notifications.type, full 11-member union. notifications.create tRPC input restricts to the first 4.

enums.name: ReviewType
enums.description: reviews.type, derived from reviewer role.

enums.name: MissionStatus
enums.description: missions.status, default OPEN. Cabinet updateStatus tRPC only allows FILLED|CANCELLED.

enums.name: BookingStatus
enums.description: bookings.status, default PENDING. Instant bookings start CONFIRMED. respond tRPC allows CONFIRMED|REJECTED.

enums.name: MissionApplicationStatus
enums.description: missionApplications.status, default PENDING. respondToApplication allows ACCEPTED|REJECTED.

enums.name: HealthProfession
enums.description: doctorProfiles.profession (varchar 50), default MEDECIN. From PROFESSION_IDS in lib/constants.ts.

enums.name: MedicalSpecialty
enums.description: 29-member medicalSpecialtySchema z.enum (note the verbatim typo ORTHOPEDYE). Stored as plain text in the specialties table and as json string[] on profiles; not enforced by any DB constraint.

enums.name: SpecialtyCategory
enums.description: specialties.category values from SPECIALTY_CATEGORIES; default fallback medical.

enums.name: DayKey
enums.description: Keys of generalAvailability json object (GeneralAvailability).

enums.name: AdapterAccountType
enums.description: accounts.type — $type<AdapterAccount["type"]> from next-auth/adapters; members are the next-auth standard set, not literally enumerated in this codebase.

enums.name: VerificationMethod
enums.description: PractitionerVerificationResult.verificationMethod: FR=api (Annuaire Santé), BE/CH=format-only, DE=manual (document review).

enums.name: Currency
enums.description: Country config currency: FR/BE/DE=EUR, CH=CHF.

interfaces.notes: Registration (doctor or cabinet). bcrypt-hashes password (cost 12). Anti-abuse rate limited per IP and per email.
interfaces.input: { name: string min 2, email: string email, password: string 8..128 + regex (one lower, one upper, one digit), role: Role enum [CABINET|DOCTOR|ADMIN], country: Country enum [FR|BE|DE|CH] } (registerApiSchema = registerBaseSchema.omit confirmPassword)
interfaces.output: { success: true, message: 'Compte créé avec succès. Vérifiez votre email.', user: { id, email, name, role } }
sideEffects: Rate limit register-ip: 5/hour per ctx.ip; inserts rateLimitAttempts row
Rate limit register-email: 3/day per email; inserts rateLimitAttempts row
INSERT users { name, email, password: bcrypt.hash(pw,12), role, country, emailVerified: null }
INSERT verificationTokens { identifier: email, token: uuid, expires: now+24h }
Email sendEmailVerification(email, name, token, locale) — Resend, try/catch (non-fatal)
Email sendWelcomeEmail(email, name, locale) — Resend, try/catch (non-fatal)
Errors: TOO_MANY_REQUESTS; CONFLICT 'Un utilisateur avec cet email existe déjà'; INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR on insert failure

interfaces.notes: Verify email via token.
sideEffects: UPDATE users SET emailVerified = now WHERE email = token.identifier
DELETE verificationTokens WHERE identifier AND token
Errors: NOT_FOUND invalid token; BAD_REQUEST expired link

interfaces.notes: Resend the email-verification link to the logged-in user.
sideEffects: DELETE all verificationTokens WHERE identifier = user.email
INSERT verificationTokens { identifier, token: uuid, expires: now+24h }
Email sendEmailVerification (NOT wrapped in try/catch here — throws on send failure)
Errors: NOT_FOUND user; BAD_REQUEST 'Email déjà vérifié'

interfaces.notes: Always returns success (anti-enumeration).
sideEffects: If user found: DELETE existing passwordResetTokens WHERE userId
INSERT passwordResetTokens { userId, token: uuid, expires: now+1h }
Email sendPasswordResetEmail(email, name, token, locale) — try/catch (non-fatal); link /reset-password?token=
If user unknown: no side effects, still returns success

interfaces.notes: Reset password with a valid token. Only enforces min(8) — NOT the registration complexity regex.
sideEffects: UPDATE users SET password = bcrypt.hash(pw,12) WHERE id = token.userId
DELETE passwordResetTokens WHERE id = token.id
On expired token: DELETE the token row before throwing
Errors: NOT_FOUND invalid/expired token; BAD_REQUEST expired link

services.name: Email (Resend)
services.purpose: Transactional, multilingual emails: contact requests, profile validation, welcome, password reset, email verification, bookings, mission alerts, applications, reviews, and the general contact form. Source: src/lib/email.ts.
services.request: getResend() = new Resend(env.RESEND_API_KEY || ''). All send* call getResend().emails.send({ from, to, subject, html, [replyTo] }). FROM_EMAIL = env.EMAIL_FROM || 'Medic Remplacement <noreply@medicremplacement.com>'; APP_URL = env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL || 'http://localhost:3000'; CONTACT_EMAIL = env.CONTACT_EMAIL || 'contact@medicremplacement.com'. HTML built inline; subjects via getEmailTranslations(locale).t(key).
services.response: Returns the Resend SDK send promise directly (no custom wrapping).
services.onFailure: email.ts does not catch; callers wrap in try/catch and console.error (most sends are non-fatal). Exception: directory.submitContactForm re-throws as INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR (fatal). RESEND_API_KEY falls back to empty string if unset.

services.name: Geocoding (Google Maps Geocoding API)
services.purpose: Convert an address/city string to coordinates + formatted address + smart-radius metadata. Source: src/app/api/google-maps/geocode/route.ts.
services.response: On status OK: { location: formatted_address, coordinates { lat, lng }, place_id, geocodingResult { types, geometry { bounds } } }. Otherwise 404 aucun résultat.
services.onFailure: try/catch -> console.error + 500 'Erreur lors de la géolocalisation'. 400 if input missing; 500 if API key missing.

services.name: Places Autocomplete (Google Places API)
services.request: GET /api/google-maps/autocomplete?input=<text>&country=<FR|BE|DE|CH> (min 3 chars) -> fetch maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/place/autocomplete/json with key, components=country restriction, types=(cities).
services.onFailure: Non-OK Google status -> 400 Google Places API error; outer try/catch -> 500 internal; 500 if API key missing.

services.name: Anthropic Claude (AI text generation)
services.purpose: Locale-aware bio and headline generation for doctor profiles. Source: src/server/api/routers/ai.ts.
services.request: HTTP POST https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages with header x-api-key=ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; model claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, max_tokens 1024; language instruction derived from locale (de/de-CH=German, nl=Dutch, en=English, else French).
services.response: { content: [{ text }] } -> bio.trim() / headline.trim() (headline strips surrounding quotes, max 120 chars).
services.onFailure: INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR 'AI service not configured' if no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; 'AI generation failed' if !response.ok. No DB writes.

services.name: RPPS / Practitioner verification (Annuaire Santé + FHIR)
services.purpose: FR practitioner (RPPS) lookup; other countries are format-only or manual. Source: src/lib/rpps.ts, src/lib/practitioner.ts, src/lib/country.ts.
services.request: FR only: GET https://annuaire.sante.fr/web/site/professionnel/recherche?rpps=<n> (Accept application/json, 10s timeout); fallback FHIR GET https://gateway.api.esante.gouv.fr/fhir/Practitioner?identifier=http://rpps.sante.fr|<n>&_count=1.
services.response: { verified, practitionerNumber, practitionerNumberType, firstName?, lastName?, profession?, specialty?, error?, verificationMethod: api|format|manual }.
services.onFailure: Bad format -> verified:false with format error (verificationMethod 'format'). Not found -> 'Numéro RPPS non trouvé dans l'annuaire'. Service down -> 'Service de vérification indisponible. Réessayez plus tard.' BE/CH format-only (verified:true on format match); DE manual (verified:false).

services.name: Geo utilities (internal)
services.purpose: Haversine distance and smart-radius logic over geocoding metadata; no network. Source: src/lib/geo-utils.ts.
services.request: calculateDistance(lat1,lon1,lat2,lon2); getSmartRadiusFromGeocodingResult(result, requestedRadius); isCityWideSearch(result); getDistanceClause(lat,lon,radiusKm); isWithinRadius(...).
services.response: Distances in km (2 dp), widened radius for locality/admin-area-2, raw SQL Haversine clause, or boolean.

policies.name: Rate limiter (enforceRateLimit)
policies.rule: Postgres-backed sliding window. buildRateLimitKey(action, identifier) = `${action.trim().toLowerCase()}:${identifier.trim().toLowerCase()}` (throws if identifier blank). Counts rateLimitAttempts rows WHERE key matches AND createdAt >= now - windowMs; throws TRPCError TOO_MANY_REQUESTS 'Trop de requêtes. Réessayez plus tard.' when count >= limit BEFORE inserting; then inserts one attempt row. GC: 5% probability deletes rows older than 24h (best-effort). Store: rateLimitAttempts table. Source: src/lib/rate-limit.ts.

policies.name: register-ip rate limit
policies.rule: 5 attempts per 1 hour (windowMs 3600000) per ctx.ip, action 'register-ip'. Store: rateLimitAttempts. Call site: authRouter.register.

policies.name: register-email rate limit
policies.rule: 3 attempts per 24 hours (windowMs 86400000) per input.email, action 'register-email'. Store: rateLimitAttempts. Call site: authRouter.register.

policies.name: contact-request-ip rate limit
policies.rule: 5 attempts per 1 hour per ctx.ip, action 'contact-request-ip'. Store: rateLimitAttempts. Call site: directory.submitContactRequest.

policies.name: contact-request-email rate limit
policies.rule: 3 attempts per 24 hours per input.senderEmail, action 'contact-request-email'. Store: rateLimitAttempts. Call site: directory.submitContactRequest.

policies.name: contact-form rate limit
policies.rule: 3 attempts per 1 hour per ctx.ip, action 'contact-form'. Store: rateLimitAttempts. Call site: directory.submitContactForm.

policies.name: Password complexity (registration only)
policies.rule: No single named PASSWORD_POLICY constant; rules inlined per Zod schema. STRONGEST (registration, registerBaseSchema.password): z.string().min(8).max(128).regex(/^(?=.*[a-z])(?=.*[A-Z])(?=.*\d)/) — 8..128 chars, >=1 lowercase, >=1 uppercase, >=1 digit. WEAKER elsewhere (no regex/max): login min(6); resetPassword tRPC min(8) only; reset-password page min(8) + confirm match; settings page min(1). The complexity regex is enforced ONLY at registration.

policies.name: Practitioner number format by country
policies.rule: Per src/lib/country.ts. FR (RPPS): regex /^\d{11}$/, 11 digits, automated API verification (Annuaire Santé), verificationMethod 'api', defaultDailyRate 350 EUR. BE (INAMI): regex /^\d{11}$/, 11 digits, format-only (no public API), verificationMethod 'format', 300 EUR. DE (APPROBATION): NO format/regex — practitionerFormat=null, document-based, verificationMethod 'manual', validatePractitionerFormat returns null, 450 EUR. CH (GLN): regex /^\d{13}$/, 13 digits, format-only (MedReg API needs auth), verificationMethod 'format', 1200 CHF. The number is whitespace-stripped before matching. No checksum/check-digit logic exists for any country.

policies.name: Specialties catalog
policies.rule: Specialties come from the `specialties` table (name varchar 255, category varchar 100) — plain text, NO DB constraint enforcing the catalog and NO Drizzle pgEnum. The application-layer source of truth is the 29-member medicalSpecialtySchema z.enum (MedicalSpecialty), used to validate profile/mission/alert specialties. Profiles store specialties as json string[]. Representative members: MEDECINE_GENERALE, CARDIOLOGIE, DERMATOLOGIE, PEDIATRIE, GYNECOLOGIE, PSYCHIATRIE, RADIOLOGIE, CHIRURGIE_GENERALE, MEDECINE_URGENCE, ORTHOPEDYE (verbatim typo). Categories from SPECIALTY_CATEGORIES: general/medical/technical/surgical/emergency/specialized.

policies.name: Numeric validation bounds
policies.rule: rating int 1..5; experienceYears 0..50; bio max 2000; message max 2000 (contact/mission/booking) or max 5000 (messageSchema); travelRadius 1..500; priority 1..3; alert radius 5..500 default 50; directory search radius 1..500 default 50; instantBookingMaxDistance 1..500; pagination limit 1..50 default 20, page default 1, message-page limit max 100. Phone regex /^[0-9+\-\s().]+$/.

features.name: Project Setup & Tooling
features.summary: Next.js 15 App Router, Biome, Tailwind v4, Drizzle config (postgres-js), bun scripts, Docker (Postgres + app), env wiring (DATABASE_URL, NEXTAUTH_*, RESEND, ANTHROPIC, GOOGLE_MAPS, ADMIN_ACCESS_CODE).

features.name: Internationalization
features.summary: next-intl with localePrefix 'as-needed'; 5 locales (fr default, de, nl, en, de-CH); messages/{locale}.json (~1189 leaf keys, 49 namespaces); locale-aware dates, links, and emails; getUserLocale falls back to 'fr'.

features.name: Database & Schema
features.summary: Drizzle schema (medic_-prefixed tables) for users, NextAuth tables, profiles, the specialties catalog, missions, applications, bookings, availability, alerts, messaging, reviews, notifications, contact requests, favorites, profile-views log, and rate-limit attempts. All DB enums are varchar + $type<> string unions (no pgEnum).

features.name: Authentication & Authorization
features.summary: NextAuth (credentials with bcrypt + OAuth via Drizzle adapter); email verification and password reset flows; roles CABINET/DOCTOR/ADMIN with isAdmin; self-promote via access code. Public sign-up writes only the user and a (user-FK-free) email-verification token; account/session/reset-token rows are NextAuth/flow-managed.

features.name: Profiles & Onboarding
features.summary: Cabinet and doctor profile CRUD, completion scoring, instant-booking settings, intent, and practitioner-number verification (RPPS/INAMI/GLN/Approbation by country). Profiles are created PENDING and made public only after admin approval.

features.name: Public Directory (Annuaire)
features.summary: Public search and doctor pages by slug, anonymous contact requests (lead capture), public availability, specialty counts. Anonymous contact writes a contactRequests row (no user account required); the doctor notification is owned by the Notifications feature.

features.name: Replacement Marketplace (Missions)
features.summary: Cabinets create missions (urgent if start <= 48h) with smart doctor matching and email/in-app alerts; doctors browse matched missions, apply, and track applications; cabinets respond to applications.

features.name: Availability Calendar
features.summary: Interactive click-to-toggle per-date availability (single, bulk, remove), normalized to midnight UTC with a unique (doctorProfileId, date) constraint; feeds matching and bookings.

features.name: Smart Alerts
features.summary: Doctors configure mission-alert criteria (specialties, location/radius, min daily rate, email + in-app channels); used by mission matching. Channels are boolean flags, not an enum.

features.name: AI Profile Generator
features.summary: Claude (claude-haiku-4-5) generates locale-aware bio and headline for doctors. Read-only on the DB; no persistence.

features.name: Profile Analytics
features.summary: Completion score, view stats and history (profileViewsLog), share link, mission history with estimated earnings, and the Top Remplaçant badge recompute.

features.name: Messaging
features.summary: Cabinet-initiated conversations and messages between cabinets and doctors, with unread counts and read receipts.

features.name: Bidirectional Reviews
features.summary: Doctor <-> cabinet ratings (1..5) with average-rating aggregation and ownership-scoped deletion.

features.name: Bookings
features.summary: Cabinet books a doctor on a date range (PENDING) or instant-books a verified, opted-in doctor (CONFIRMED, 24h cancellation window); doctor confirms/rejects; either party cancels.

features.name: Favorites
features.summary: Cabinets save/unsave approved doctors; public favorite counts.

features.name: Notifications
features.summary: In-app notifications (11 types) with list, unread count, mark read / mark all read, delete, and an internal create. This feature owns all notifications writes raised as side effects across the app (contact requests, approvals, bookings, reviews, favorites, missions).

features.name: Admin Validation
features.summary: Admin panels to approve/reject pending cabinet and doctor profiles (PENDING -> APPROVED/REJECTED), review DE Approbation documents, resubmit rejected profiles, and view platform stats.

features.name: SEO & Sitemap
features.summary: Schema.org Physician + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD, generateMetadata per doctor with canonical + hreflang, SSG of approved doctor pages, and a multi-locale sitemap with hreflang alternates.

features.name: Geocoding & Maps
features.summary: Server-side Google Maps geocoding and country-restricted Places autocomplete proxies (keys kept server-side); internal Haversine distance + smart-radius utilities feed search/matching.

features.name: Transactional Emails
features.summary: 13 multilingual Resend templates with recipient locale fetched from the DB per send (getUserLocale -> 'fr' fallback); most sends are non-fatal try/catch, the general contact form send is fatal.

features.name: Documentation
features.summary: CLAUDE.md, country regulatory differences (RPPS/INAMI/GLN/Approbation), README, and developer docs.

glossary.definition: A locum doctor who covers a practice temporarily.
A medical practice that posts missions and books replacements.
A replacement need posted by a Cabinet, with dates, specialty and rate; status OPEN/FILLED/CANCELLED/EXPIRED.
A doctor's goal on the platform: visibility (personal page), missions (marketplace), or both.
A badge for doctors with 10+ confirmed bookings, 3+ reviews and a 4.5+ average rating.
The public directory of APPROVED doctor profiles, indexed for SEO.
An anonymous lead from a visitor to a doctor, stored in contactRequests (no account needed); distinct from a Conversation/Message.
A national medical registry number: RPPS (FR), INAMI (BE), GLN (CH), or Approbation (DE).
A profile's moderation state: PENDING until an admin sets APPROVED or REJECTED; only APPROVED profiles are public.

decisions.title: tRPC for the API layer
decisions.context: Wanted end-to-end type safety between the Next.js client and server without hand-written API contracts.
decisions.decision: Use tRPC routers as the primary API instead of REST controllers.
decisions.why: Type inference across the boundary eliminates a class of integration bugs and removes schema duplication; REST is kept only for NextAuth, the tRPC fetch adapter, the Google Maps proxies, and the sitemap.

decisions.title: Drizzle ORM over Prisma
decisions.context: Needed a typed Postgres layer with predictable SQL and lightweight migrations.
decisions.decision: Adopt Drizzle ORM (postgres-js) with drizzle-kit migrations; model DB enums as varchar columns with TypeScript $type<> string unions rather than pgEnum.
decisions.why: Closer-to-SQL queries, smaller runtime, first-class TS types, and string-union enums that evolve without a DB migration.

decisions.title: next-intl with localePrefix 'as-needed'
decisions.context: Five locales including a regional variant (de-CH); French is the default market.
decisions.decision: Use next-intl with no URL prefix for the default locale (fr) and prefixes for de/nl/en/de-CH.
decisions.why: Clean canonical URLs for the primary market while still serving correct hreflang and SEO for the others.

decisions.title: Admin validation gate for profiles
decisions.context: Medical directory credibility depends on vetting practitioners across FR/BE/DE/CH regulatory regimes.
decisions.decision: Profiles start PENDING and require admin APPROVED before appearing publicly; DE Approbation is reviewed as an uploaded document (manual).
decisions.why: Trust and regulatory compliance outweigh onboarding friction; the explicit state machine makes the gate auditable.

decisions.title: Anonymous contact via contactRequests, not Conversations
decisions.context: Visitors must be able to contact a doctor without creating an account, but Conversations require both a doctor and a cabinet profile.
decisions.decision: Store anonymous leads in a dedicated contactRequests table (sender name/email/phone, no user FK); raise the doctor notification and emails as side effects.
decisions.why: Keeps the anonymous write satisfiable by an account-less caller while still notifying the doctor and feeding analytics/reviews.

decisions.title: Postgres-backed sliding-window rate limiting
decisions.context: Public sign-up and contact endpoints need abuse protection without an external store.
decisions.decision: Count rows in a rateLimitAttempts table within a window and insert one row per attempt, with probabilistic GC.
decisions.why: No extra infrastructure (Redis); transactional with the rest of the app; per-IP and per-email keys cover the abuse vectors.
